description: Fork of exp593 (1.4337 SoTA, read_out NAP=5). SINGLE change: out_proj uses sparse-scatter output, out_n_sparse=64 per table (local), sparse_scatter_n_outputs=E=384 (global). Trunk bandwidth 75.5 -> 12.6 Mbits/tok contribution (-62.9 Mbits trunk). Predicted total ~135.3M params, ~92 Mbits trunk, ~495 Mbits total. If lucky (per-layer out_proj has redundant depth), close to exp593.
